facts.P1_fx_receipts: Dollarised economy; use banks or licensed transfer operators, not informal hawala.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Very likely: banking and mobile money run in US dollars; not confirmed.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Mobile money (like EVC Plus) dominates; no online merchant gateway confirmed.
facts.L1_registration: Register online with the federal business registration system, about four days.
facts.L4_vat_gst: No VAT; sales tax rates conflict (5% or 10%).
facts.L5_data_protection: Data Protection Act 2023; large data controllers must register.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
